mapper.select: SELECT t_apply_bidding.id, t_apply_bidding.tender_number AS tenderNumber, t_apply_bidding.customer_id AS customerId, t_apply_bidding.customer AS customer, t_apply_bidding.bidding_mode AS biddingMode, t_apply_bidding.materiel_no AS materielNo, t_apply_bidding.materiel_name AS materielName, t_sales_bidding.area_no AS areaNo, t_sales_bidding.area_name AS areaName, t_sales_bidding.delivery_place_no AS deliveryPlaceNo, t_sales_bidding.delivery_place_name AS deliveryPlaceName, t_sales_bidding.delivery_place_class_no AS deliveryPlaceClassNo, t_sales_bidding.delivery_place_class_name AS deliveryPlaceClassName, t_sales_bidding.delivery_method AS deliveryMethod, t_sales_bidding.shipping_type AS shippingType, -- t_apply_bidding.contacts AS contacts, -- t_sales_bidding.application_time AS applicationTime, t_apply_bidding.status AS status, t_sales_bidding.depot_no AS depotNo, t_sales_bidding.depot_name AS depotName FROM t_apply_bidding LEFT JOIN t_sales_bidding ON t_apply_bidding.tender_number = t_sales_bidding.tender_number WHERE t_apply_bidding.is_deleted = #{param.deleted} and t_apply_bidding.tender_number = #{param.tenderNumber} ORDER BY t_apply_bidding.gmt_modified ASC

SELECT t_apply_bidding.tender_number AS tenderNumber, t_apply_bidding.customer AS customer, t_sales_bidding.latest_quotation AS latestQuotation, t_sales_bidding.bidding_description AS biddingDescription FROM t_apply_bidding LEFT JOIN t_sales_bidding ON t_apply_bidding.tender_number = t_sales_bidding.tender_number WHERE t_apply_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_apply_bidding.id = #{param.id}

SELECT t_apply_bidding.customer AS customer, t_apply_bidding.latest_quotation AS latestQuotation FROM t_apply_bidding WHERE t_apply_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_apply_bidding.tender_number = #{param.tenderNumber} AND t_apply_bidding.win_bid_status = '已中标'
SELECT t_apply_bidding.customer AS customer FROM t_apply_bidding WHERE t_apply_bidding.is_deleted = '0' AND t_apply_bidding.latest_quotation = #{param.latestQuotation}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_apply_bidding (tender_number, customer_id, customer, customer_ip, bidding_mode, materiel_no, materiel_name, status, company_no, company_name, create_by, create_by_name) VALUES (#{tenderNumber}, #{customerId}, #{customer}, #{customerIp}, #{biddingMode}, #{materielNo}, #{materielName}, #{status}, #{companyNo}, #{companyName}, #{createBy}, #{createByName})
mapper.select: SELECT t_sales_bidding.tender_number AS tenderNumber, t_apply_bidding.customer_id AS customerId FROM t_apply_bidding LEFT JOIN t_sales_bidding ON t_apply_bidding.tender_number = t_sales_bidding.tender_number WHERE t_apply_bidding.id = #{id} AND t_apply_bidding.status = '审核通过'
select count(t_apply_bidding.tender_number) from t_apply_bidding where is_deleted = 0 and t_apply_bidding.status = '已报名' and t_apply_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber}
mapper.update: update t_apply_bidding set t_apply_bidding.status = '审核拒绝' where t_apply_bidding.tender_number = #{tenderNumber} and t_apply_bidding.status != '审核通过'
